causal_scope: input-sensitive one-call stages, not the full legacy APHHM runtime
finding: Visible answer options enter candidate generation, supply benchmark surfaces, and collapse search; clinical-block organization materially moderates the effect.
refutes: answer options are a harmless display layer
equal aggregate scores imply equal trajectories

anchors: No predefined arm contrast survives Holm correction
causal_scope: measurement and frozen-output anatomy; historical arm differences are not fresh runtime effects
design: method-blind heterogeneous review followed by exhaustive root adjudication and design weighting
finding: Strict, task-projected, clinically complete, and complete-or-partial outcomes are different objects; only 55.82% of full references are uniquely identifiable, and no predefined arm contrast survives Holm correction.
refutes: one correctness flag measures clinical output quality
heterogeneous reviewer consensus is a safe endpoint

anchors: only seven DA cases are strictly exposed
causal_scope: selector behavior on one frozen candidate/evidence state, chiefly exposed MCR cases
design: five selectors on the same blinded canonical pool and evidence table
finding: Forest-style evidence integration converts an exposed fixed pool better than the e7 contrast selector, but exposure is the dominant bottleneck and exhaustive pairwise tournament adds cost without a demonstrated gain.
refutes: generation alone explains all method differences
evidence count or exhaustive tournament is sufficient

anchors: Candidate-set context is itself causally active
causal_scope: gold-exposed constructed pools; typed-label construction errors limit relation-specific subarms
design: nine-arm candidate-membership intervention with byte-stable shared labels and order
finding: Candidate independence is false: plausible siblings and wider pools harm both by direct alternative capture and by reordering unchanged candidates; DA and MCR express different interference mechanisms.
refutes: more candidates are monotonically safer
removing a loser cannot change the winner among survivors

anchors: 25 例至少有一条关系语义错误
causal_scope: the tested generative graph constructor and selector, not all structured representations
design: raw vignette versus quoted flat facts versus generated typed event graph
finding: The tested generated graph is a lossy and error-adding representation: relations are new clinical claims, not formatting, and its clinical-complete endpoint is materially worse than raw text.
refutes: typed graph generation is lossless
explicit time/scope fields are reliable merely because present

causal_scope: tokenization and one representation perturbation; provider/time effects remain a runtime limitation
design: remove only the flat-fact sentinel padding while freezing facts and selector contract
finding: Whitespace-matched sentinel padding inflated prompt tokens catastrophically but did not explain the semantic quality effect; tiny nonclinical input changes can still send the generator to different trajectories.
refutes: whitespace word matching equalizes model input
padding alone explains flat-fact quality

causal_scope: identity/exposure replay, not fresh selector accuracy
design: full 800-case offline replay of legacy substring versus exact frozen-synonym identity
finding: Substring identity is not benign deduplication: it folds non-synonyms, transfers evidence, and erases separately addressable concepts.
refutes: substring containment is a safe equivalence relation

causal_scope: unsafe-fold development cases under a fixed-width selector payload
design: fresh blinded selector on legacy, exact, and generic-relation counterfactual registries
finding: Exact identity is a safety/addressability invariant and restores reference exposure, but it is not a stand-alone top-1 cure; generic non-equivalence prose changes champions without useful direction.
refutes: safe identity repair alone fixes ranking
undirected non-equivalence text supplies task projection

causal_scope: the implemented LLM relation typer, not an oracle typed ontology
design: fixed exact-identity pools with LLM directional relations and bounded inheritance
finding: The realised directional graph is too inconsistent for deployment; relation wording and even irrelevant graph context act as salience perturbations.
refutes: free-form directional annotation is ready for evidence inheritance

causal_scope: fixed pools with a generated negative ledger; builder errors are part of the treatment risk
design: hard versus time/scope soft veto plus legal-order and invalid-time perturbations
finding: Atemporal absolute veto is clinically unsafe; softening it removes invalid reference vetoes but does not by itself identify a superior ranker, and time/order perturbations reveal large near-zero-net trajectory instability.
refutes: missing a typical finding safely excludes a diagnosis
time fields guarantee correct temporal reasoning

anchors: 10 个 strict real-only 中只有 6
causal_scope: joint effect of extra view content on union plus selection; role/duplicate flips are instability upper bounds
design: real views, role rotation, one balanced anchor, and exact duplicate-view placebo
finding: Forest views are correlated but retain a small real coverage increment; their benefit is not independent voting, and duplicate/role perturbations expose selector path dependence.
refutes: three views are three independent votes
duplicate evidence should raise confidence

anchors: 合计只新增 6 个概念
causal_scope: homogeneous Llama panel on development cases; unique relation novelty was not measured
design: doctor history isolated/sequential crossed with deterministic RRF/closed-pool Supervisor
finding: Sequential history compresses candidate diversity dramatically but improves current-sample rank conversion; the Supervisor is a small semantic rescue when minority opinions exist, not the source of diversity loss.
refutes: sequential discussion creates independent expert search
Supervisor is the primary diversity bottleneck

causal_scope: the current lexical bundle contract, not ideal typed RAG; complete+partial refine is secondary
design: retrieval off/query-top/random/hard-negative crossed with refine off/on
finding: The tested retriever supplies weak topical context rather than case-specific relations; query-top context tends to flatten specificity, while generic refine changes many trajectories but has no primary complete-endpoint advantage.
refutes: query-top text is clinically relevant evidence
a generic second-pass refine is a safe fallback

causal_scope: frozen historical e7 candidate pools; raw includes occasional author diagnostic assertions
design: raw/S1/graph by k5/k10 by first/pointwise/pairwise plus frozen depth path
finding: On frozen candidate pools, an explicit raw-text comparator beats blindly taking the historical first candidate; S1 loses decisive relations, graph does not repair them, width is not monotone, and most apparent depth effects are not attributable to new information.
refutes: historical candidate order is a sufficient selector
S1 or generated graph is a safe sole representation
extra selector samples measure call-depth value

anchors: 135 个新实体没有一个严格命中
6 个观察到的临床 repair、15 个 harm、13 个 neutral
causal_scope: deployment decision on the current gate; no causal coefficient for an ideal relation-aware Call-4
design: retrospective strict-gate funnel with exhaustive root review of triggered champion flips
finding: The realised unexplained-span/low-margin fourth-call gate adds many surviving entities but no strict reference discovery; its clinical flips are harm-heavy and the historical upstream states are not causally exchangeable.
refutes: unexplained span count is an adequate call target
more surviving novelty implies utility

causal_scope: the realised generated skeleton/typed-candidate/frontier implementation on a development relation challenge set
design: pre-frozen Lite3, relation-preserving RCR3, and true-third-generator Compact4 arms
finding: The default RCR-3 implementation fails its fidelity, exposure, reliability, and conversion criteria; safe identity survives, but generated structure plus fixed frontier and self-calibrated completeness lose to the simpler Lite path.
refutes: current RCR-3 is the default three-call replacement
generated relation fields and self-reported completeness are trustworthy
